84.description: This feature vector is related to Thai script tokens and common Thai syllable fragments containing the character 'เป' (pe).

77.description: This feature vector activates on non-English script fragments, Latin letters, and prefixes common in foreign or scientific terminology.

149.description: This feature vector represents the Thai vowel sign 'โ' (O-vowel) in various character combinations and contexts.

167.description: This vector represents common Thai character combinations and linguistic suffixes alongside noisy ASCII fragments.

94.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ส' (so suea) across various syllable blocks, vowel combinations, and words.

177.description: This feature vector represents common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles used to connect words and phrases.

173.description: This feature vector activates on tokens related to opiates, alkaloids, and various non-English scripts, particularly Thai characters and diacritics.

106.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and words or letter combinations containing it, alongside unrelated English terms like 'opioid'.

40.description: This feature activates on a random, highly heterogeneous mix of subword fragments, punctuation marks, and multi-lingual characters with no unifying semantic theme.

130.description: This feature vector represents linguistic subwords, fragments, and affixes shared across multiple languages, including English, Thai, and Latin-derived terms.
